newsitem.title: USA: J. Ray McDermott gets $145 million in contracts.
newsitem.headline: J. Ray McDermott gets $145 million in contracts.

text.p: J. Ray McDermott, a major worldwide marine construction company, said Friday it has won contracts worth $145 million for work in the Gulf of Thailand.
Unocal Corp.'s Thailand subsidiary and its partners awarded the contract for the first phase in the development in Unocal's Pailin natural gas field, J. Ray McDermott said.
Unocal's partners in the project include Amerada Hess Corp., PTT Exploration & Production Public Co. and Moeco Thai Oil Development Co. Ltd., the operator of the field, J. Ray McDermott said.

J. Ray McDermott said the work will be jointly managed by Unocal and McDermott representatives and will provide for the engineering, procurement and construction management for installation of 17,000 tons of offshore equipment and pipelines.
The facilities will be ready for start-up by Dec. 1, 1998, the New Orleans-based company said.
The facilities will be fabricated at J. Ray McDermott's fabrication facility on Batam Island, Indonesia.
J. Ray McDermott's stock rose 37.5 cents to $23.25 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
